# gpu_warp_test's rotation source (README WA33): a 128x64 frame as Desktop Duplication hands it over, in the panel's
# own orientation, in 8x8 blocks. The red "F" sits at the top left, so each of rotation_90/180/270.txt shows where
# the converters must put it (04 section 7.9: ROTATE90 turns the frame 90 degrees clockwise).
size 128 64
scale 8
palette
k FF000000
w FFFFFFFF
r FFE02020
g FF20C040
b FF2040E0
y FFF0E020
c FF20D0E0
m FFD040C0
pixels
rrrrkkkkkkkkwwww
rbbbkkkkkkkkwggw
rbkkkkkkkkkkwggw
rbbbkkkkyyyywwww
rbkkkkkkyyyycccc
rbkkkkkkkkkkcmmc
rkkkkkkkkkkkcmmc
kkkkkkkkkkkkcccc
